notes: The quote table is split into sections - Services, Crew, Equipment hire, Travel and accommodation, Other charges - in that order, skipping any section with nothing in it, and each one carrying a subtotal where it has more than one line. Crew rows can now say what they cover and what they are counting: a description that shows under the role on the quote, and a unit, so a travel-day line reads 4 crew times 250 pounds rather than being forced into days. A cost can be a quantity at a rate instead of a lump - a hotel is rooms times nights times a nightly rate, with its own description underneath - and the Hotel and Train quick-add buttons now arrive with Rebill already ticked, which is why they seemed to do nothing before: they were landing as internal costs that never reached a quote. There is also a production fee: leave the percentage blank on jobs that do not have one, or set it and pick what it is charged on - hire and logistics, crew and hire and logistics, or the whole quote - and it is worked out fresh every time, so it follows the numbers instead of going stale when a hire price moves. It can never be part of its own base.
